newsitem.title: USA: SEC eases odd-lot tender offer rules.
newsitem.headline: SEC eases odd-lot tender offer rules.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission said on Monday it eased the rules for odd-lot tender offers to remove regulatory obstacles to odd-lot programs conducted simultaneously with open-market share repurchase programs and employee stock purchase plans.
The SEC also eased a requirement that a record date be declared to determine odd-lot program eligibility. The agency said that rule had unnecessarily excluded some shareholders from odd-lot programs.
The agency also said it would consider, on a case-by-case basis, allowing issuers to make odd-lot tender offers available to holders of more than 99 shares.
